beats.vo: The Great Pyramid has a ramp hidden inside it.
Two point three million blocks. One every three minutes.
An outside ramp would be over a mile long.
beats.sub: an outside ramp — bigger than the pyramid

beats.vo: A spiral tunnel in the edges, with open corners to turn each block.
The sixty-ton beams? A counterweight, sliding down the Grand Gallery.
And in twenty-seventeen, scanners found a hidden void... right above it.
Thirty meters long. Nobody has been inside. Yet.
Would you go in? A or B.

metadata.title: The Great Pyramid Has a Ramp HIDDEN INSIDE It 🔺 Would you go in?
metadata.description:
2.3 million blocks, one every 3 minutes. An outside ramp would be 1.6 km long — so engineer Jean-Pierre Houdin proposed an internal spiral ramp and a counterweight in the Grand Gallery for the 60-ton beams. In 2017, ScanPyramids found a 30 m void right above it. Nobody has been inside.

3D reconstruction by Ancient Tech. Would you go in? Comment A or B.

Sources: Houdin & Brier, 'The Secret of the Great Pyramid'; ScanPyramids, Nature 2017.
